title: Deliver Fruit to Tedingstone Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Fruit** delivered to **Tedingstone Food Processing Plant** (industry id 16, near tile 33,25).

A likely supplier is **Plaham Fruit Plantation** (industry id 6, near tile 51,44); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **400 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
